run_deit_training: run the DeiT training script with default args on ImageNet using python main.py --data-path /path/to/imagenet
run_deit_evaluation: run evaluation only on a trained DeiT model using python main.py --eval --resume checkpoint.pth
run_deit_finetuning: run DeiT finetuning from a pretrained checkpoint using python main.py --finetune pretrained.pth --data-path /data
run_deit_distillation: run DeiT training with knowledge distillation using python main.py --distillation-type soft --teacher-path teacher.pth
run_deit_distributed: run distributed DeiT training across multiple GPUs using torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 main.py --data-path /data
